definitions.gloss: living away from one's family for work; solo work transfer
definitions.explanation: When an employee is transferred to a distant workplace and moves there alone, leaving their family behind. A common phenomenon in Japanese corporate culture where employees are reassigned to branch offices in other cities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単身|たんしん}{赴任|ふにん}{中|ちゅう}だ。
examples.english: My father is currently living away from us for work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{単身|たんしん}{赴任|ふにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Starting next month, I'll be transferred to Osaka on my own.

examples.japanese: {単身|たんしん}{赴任|ふにん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}い→会う：00482_au⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}っている→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Living alone for work is lonely, but I go home to see my family on weekends.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common term in Japanese corporate life. Companies frequently transfer employees to branch offices across the country, and many workers choose to go alone rather than uproot their families, especially if children are in school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単身|たんしん}{赴任|ふにん}{中|ちゅう} (currently on solo transfer)
- {単身|たんしん}{赴任|ふにん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (life away from family for work)
- {単身|たんしん}{赴任|ふにん}{手当|てあて} (solo transfer allowance)
- {単身|たんしん}{赴任|ふにん}{先|さき} (transfer destination)
